name: Why does painting a foreclosed property cost more than a regular paint job?
description: Foreclosed homes often need extra prep, repairs, and cleanup, which raises the price beyond a standard repaint.

mainEntity.name: Why does painting a foreclosed property cost more than a regular paint job?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest cost drivers are square footage, how much prep is needed, and whether repairs are required before painting starts. Foreclosed properties often cost more than a normal repaint because of patching, stain blocking, cleanup, and extra surface preparation.
